notes.title: New Chapter Update
notes.content:
New Features

Chapter 5
'lever' tile
'button' tile
Special levels


Changes

Fixed many known bugs
Textures and graphical changes
Updated step limit for some levels
Updated undo limit for some levels


New Chapter
In this new chapter, we added 2 puzzle element: the lever and button which can toggle the states of all other puzzle elements of the same color. The new chapter contains 38 new unique levels, with more to be added later!
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/aa1acaed8edcb5cc83a46b58caa68998900b4563.png

Special Levels
New Special levels have been added for each chapter! They are special in that they involve some unusual challenges not found in normal levels.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/89e42e08a24f27f4f4a81c77dd542a5c958153db.png

New Levels, New features, New challenges awaits!

'Lever' Switch
When there are objects on the lever, it will toggle the on/off state of all puzzle elements of the same color (such as players/boxes, portals, lasers, ect.) .  The disabled elements will cease functions until re enabled. When the object leaves the lever, the toggled state will remain until stepped on again.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/068669a72456cb9883c2afcf4231a833fb274ca1.png

'button' Switch
Similar to the Lever, but the toggled state will revert when the object leaves
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/fe400af4481457470a430dc01785c0c627d07675.png

Simultaneous Activation 
There may be multiple levers/buttons in the same level, if multiple is activated at the same time, they will all trigger simultaneously.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/76a3661cf1df7ec141d57a95e79a45a06472c3f4.gif

Player? Box?
When players are toggled off, they turn into boxes. You can use this to bypass damaging effects.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/873c607385474f5370543db497e9270b7aa9fbab.gif

Thats all for this update.

We hope you all enjoy the game!

notes.title: New Chapter Update!
notes.content:
Added

 Chapter 4 Levels
 Lasers
 Box


Changes

 Fix rendering issues
 Removed auto restart
 Updated step limits
 Updated undo limits


Added a brand new chapter!
In this chapter, there are 2 new puzzle elements that interact with existing elements in interesting ways, featuring 43 new unique levels with more to come.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/7047d5d76812ecbfbd9f97418d36daa27b2654f7.png

New chapter, new challenges awaits!

New: Box blocks
They can be pushed by players, but do not move on their own.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/558a35b22ddd9d841105669c7ba98bb8cbd8fc70.png

They will ignore damage from other sources, which can be used to subvert danger.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/cac2a350f0e81a85af13f79223af2a6438f6eaa0.png


New: Lasers
They are emitted from players or boxes; be careful, they will destroy players.
They can be blocked by walls and boxes but will go through glass.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/63cfbadd53c2ffd1e92e9e54112d8217d9982344.png

They will go through portals, including getting duplicated by multiple exits.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/1634cc3da189bb20e505e4af979056efdd0cda1b.png

They can have different colors, which will interact with color changers, and have an explosive secret.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/1603509aecdda64205b91ca5f4be746e79169bbb.gif



This concludes the new features in this update,

We hope for your continued support in the future to release more updates!
